annotations.title: Get Agentic Base USDC Payment Intent (HTTP 402 / x402)

description: Retrieve the machine-readable HTTP 402 / x402 Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) USDC payment intent for an unpaid job_id so an autonomous wallet (AgentKit, OpenClaw, EVM signer) can settle on-chain without a browser. Call after calligraphy_compile_board for Base USDC treasury settlement. Requires job_id; returns JSON recipient_wallet and erc681_uri. Example: job_id='job_01'.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier requiring Base USDC x402 settlement.
